message: Hey Jane! How are you? I've been hearing a lot about the Wildcats lately. How's the team shaping up for the State Championships? Any standout stars this year?
Jane, don't forget about the parent-teacher meeting tomorrow at 4 PM!
Good morning Coach Doe, this is a reminder that the track uniforms will be ready for pickup tomorrow.
Jane, can you send me the latest draft of the training schedule? Thanks!
Urgent: The venue for next week's regional qualifiers has been changed. Please inform the team.
Jane, this is a gentle reminder to update the team's dietary plans. Let's ensure they're all set for the big day!
Hey, I saw Michael limping a bit during practice yesterday. Is he okay?
Jane, the forecast says it might rain during our practice session tomorrow. Should we book the indoor track?
Don't forget to submit the final roster for the State Championships by Thursday.
Morning Jane! If you need extra help with the event planning, let me know.
